Requirement: Detect the emotion of the user's own message across 32 categories
How it was verified: Fine-tuned RoBERTa-base evaluated on the official test partition (2,542 conversations)
Result: Top-1 50.3%, top-3 76.5%, top-5 84.3% against a chance level of 3.1%

Requirement: Expose more than one candidate emotion with confidence
How it was verified: Top-3 accuracy of the detector; stage-1 selection measured against the gold label
Result: Correct emotion is among the top 3 for 76.5% of messages; the generator picks it 42.3% of the time

Requirement: Report the candidate emotions, the chosen emotion and the words behind the decision
How it was verified: Inspection of the agent output for every turn; attention cues taken from the detector's [CLS] attention
Result: Met - every turn prints the three candidates with confidence, the chosen emotion and the cue words

Requirement: Give the generator wording written for the selected emotion
How it was verified: Compared with the same detector and generator using one generic prompt (top-1 configuration)
Result: Emotion validation 36.7% against 28.3% (adjusted p = 0.003); WASSA 5.05 against 4.89

Requirement: Acknowledge the feeling, ask exactly one question, stay within 120 words
Result: Acknowledgement 66.3%, exactly one question 92.7%, within the length limit 100%, all three together 60.0%

Requirement: Support a multi-turn conversation and follow a change of emotion
How it was verified: Multi-turn agent built on the same components; detector reads the last four user turns
Result: Met - agent runs with a 10-exchange memory and reports a detected emotion shift

Requirement: Run within 8 GB of GPU memory
How it was verified: Measured over 50 messages on an RTX 4060 8 GB
Result: 3.40 GB peak, against 5.47 GB for the 7.6B single model (38% less)

Requirement: No user message has to leave the device
How it was verified: Review of every component; only EmpatheticDialogues text was sent to the judge APIs
Result: Met - detector and generator run locally; external services were used for evaluation only

Requirement: Produce a reply in a few seconds
Result: 4.17 s per reply on average (65.7 ms per generated token); detection and emotion selection add 0.31 s

Requirement: Every number reproducible from scripts and saved outputs
How it was verified: Fixed seeds; scored prediction files kept for all systems; tables regenerated by script
Result: Met - 4,200 scored replies and 1,024 judge ratings are stored in the repository

Requirement: Components replaceable and testable on their own
How it was verified: Detector swapped for RoBERTa-large and for the earlier GPT-2 detector with the generator held fixed
Result: Met - swaps ran without any change to the generator; neither improved reply quality significantly

Requirement: Use only open models, datasets and free service tiers
How it was verified: Licence review of every asset; cost record
Result: Met - no paid service was used at any stage
